hero.title: Śrī Kṛṣṇa <1/>Janmāṣṭamī
hero.subtitle: A Divine Invitation
hero.description: You are joyfully invited to celebrate the divine appearance of Lord Sri Krishna. Immerse yourself in a day of ecstatic kirtan, enlightening discourse, and transcendental festivities.

details.title: Join the Celebration
details.registrationInfo: Register online to get a <1>Special Entry Pass</1> and confirm your presence at this auspicious event. We look forward to welcoming you.

inspiration.title: Divine Inspiration
inspiration.subtitle: Watch and immerse yourself in the glories of Lord Krishna and His devotees.
